settings.title: Import products
settings.body: Run **Import products** to scan the listing URL and create catalog entries. The job is chunked: the host keeps calling it and checkpoints progress after every product, so you can close the page and come back. Adjust what it imports in the panel below.

settings.title: Preview a product parse (pass a product URL as input)

jobs.name: Import products
jobs.description: Scans the listing URL and imports every product it finds (one product per step, chunked across ticks).

jobs.name: Refresh prices & variants
jobs.description: Re-checks imported SKUs on OTRCat and updates price, variants and categories when they changed.

jobs.name: Test fetch
jobs.description: Fetches the listing URL a number of times to verify connectivity, permissions and progress reporting.

jobs.name: Probe store capabilities
jobs.description: Imports one image from a URL and creates/updates a hidden draft product — verifies ctx.files and ctx.products end to end.

jobs.name: Preview a product parse
jobs.description: Fetches one product URL and returns the parsed fields plus the product payload it would save — writes nothing. Use it to test the parser.

configSchema.label: Listing URL
configSchema.description: OTRCat page that lists the products to import. The importer follows the page's Next links, so keep it paginated (limit=100).

configSchema.label: Max products (0 = all)
configSchema.description: Stop after importing this many products. Useful for a first test run.

configSchema.label: Price multiplier
configSchema.description: Multiplies every scraped price (base price and variants). 1 = OTRCat prices, 1.5 = +50%.

configSchema.label: Skip products that already exist
configSchema.description: When on, SKUs already in the catalog are left untouched. Turn off to update them instead.

configSchema.label: Import product artwork
configSchema.description: Downloads the OTRCat cover image into your store's file storage.

configSchema.label: AI copy (description + bullets)
configSchema.description: Rewrites the description and generates bullet points through your AI provider. Slower — roughly one product per tick.

configSchema.label: AI main image
configSchema.description: Generates the main image from the OTRCat artwork through your saved AI image prompt. Off = import the original artwork.

configSchema.label: AI image prompt id
configSchema.description: Saved AI prompt to use (Dashboard → AI Prompts). Used when AI main image is on.

configSchema.label: AI image size
configSchema.description: Requested output size, e.g. 2048x2048. The provider may snap to a supported size.

configSchema.label: Custom AI description prompt
configSchema.description: Optional. Overrides the built-in description prompt (the product data is appended automatically).

configSchema.label: Bullet points per product
configSchema.description: How many AI bullet points to generate.

configSchema.label: Use HTML proxy for fetching
configSchema.description: Route page fetches through the html-scraper proxy (needs the API key below). Off = fetch OTRCat directly.

configSchema.label: Proxy API key
configSchema.description: Optional key for the html-scraper proxy. Stored encrypted.

configSchema.label: Test fetch: pages to request
configSchema.description: Used by the Test fetch job only.
